scope: Post-evaluation diagnosis on all five original complete TEST populations; R4 and V3 separately; previously exposed exploratory data
truth_use: Only after original frozen predictions and completed evaluation; no scores changed
budget_rule: For each task and each channel/stage independently, ceil(0.05*N) descending alarms with stable original-order tie breaks. All five populations contain zero unknown tokens.

representative_selection.rule: Within each task and diagnostic category, sort largest ordinal-rank flip (or worst common-FN rank), stable original-order ties; select up to three distinct source IDs. Categories overlap and are not prevalence estimates.
representative_selection.source_excerpts: Automatic lexical windows; full source remains in bound prepared inference inputs; windows are not entailment proofs.

active_input_interpretation: Either raw channel top5 is available primitive-view information, not necessarily an input to the detector.
For Summary the R4 full-only recipe omits local, so local-only high ranks are view omission, not downstream R4 suppression.

For pair-view R4, two separate raw-view ranks and the average point rank use different complete-task orderings; a loss before point is a view-combination/global-ranking observation, not an independent causal experiment.
Active-input top5 to final below top5 is a descriptive rank loss at fixed budget; intermediates also recover other positives.

Released positive character spans may contain individually supported words attached to a wrong citation, entity/event, time or scope relation; do not equate every labeled token with an independently false statement.

QA.scope: post-evaluation diagnostic; original complete TEST; no new detector or tuning
interpretation_limits: Top5 membership is a fixed-budget relative rank, not a semantic support test; rank losses are not automatically causal harm.
Raw-stage and final-stage alarms each use their own task-wide top5 budget, not a shared numeric threshold.
V1 shared, V2 persistent and V3 witness are alternative readouts; their pairwise transitions are not sequential causal stages.
R4 prior/source calibration can introduce ties; CDF and route/innovation/stitching stages are dependent, not independent causes.
A benchmark FP is outside released positive spans, not necessarily independently verified semantic correctness; silver edit labels can miss pre-existing errors.
Span any-hit/complete-hit are added diagnostics over observable released positive spans; they do not replace official token metrics.
All populations were previously exposed and are exploratory; no new method, threshold, fitting or selection is performed.

V3_context_algebra.definition: cached witness_score minus production witness_emissions(raw_full); no new inference
